name: RAM DISPLAY menu row
entry: not a key combination: no instruction in the recovered code sets this bit; it is only ever whole-byte-copied from the stored settings struct at FFEF416E. Reachable only by restoring a settings image whose byte 0x8E4D has bit 7 set.
evidence: sub_FFF095E3 returns menu_table[11].count+1 when the bit is set; OPTION count is 4 and RAM DISPLAY is slot index 4, the one slot in the whole 20-byte table outside every count range

name: RAM DISPLAY screen
entry: same gate; 4 pages selected by RAM byte 0x00008C4C, clamped to 3
evidence: jump table of 4 handlers at FFED75FC = FFF0A8A6 FFF0A8B8 FFF0A958 FFF0A9B9; page 1 (FFF0A8B8) walks a 3-entry pointer table at RAM 0x00069310 and prints 5-digit values, i.e. a RAM monitor

name: WX ALERT menu row
evidence: sub_FFF095E3 returns menu_table[4].count-1 when the byte at 0x8C53 is 0; SIGNALING count is 14 and its last item is WX ALERT, a US-market NOAA weather-alert feature

name: DSP WRITE MODE
gate: unknown - reached from sub_FFF0D6D9 and FFF0CF6F, entry condition not traced
entry: NOT DETERMINED. No key combination was confirmed; do not assume one.
evidence: sub_FFF0DE56 composes ---DSP WRITE MODE----, Push DISP Key!, Loading..., Complete into a stack buffer and draws them; its only caller is sub_FFF0D6D9 at FFF0D709

name: PASSWORD INPUT / ENTRY
evidence: the CONFIG label array holds PASSWORD at FFC3E3AD, item 12 of 22; the input screen is sub_FFEE80A9

name: LANGUAGE switch
gate: settings byte 0x00008F72 == 1 selects the generic English 20-byte label table
evidence: sub_FFF0964A: if the byte at 0x8F72 is 1 it draws menu_table[cat].labels[item], otherwise it dispatches to a per-category localised draw function

name: MODEL CODE : APY03D
evidence: APY03D is the FT3D model code; it also appears twice in the MAIN image at 0x4B182 and 0x4B18A

name: FT1D / FT2D / FT3D model table
evidence: three 7-byte model slots FT1D, FT2D, FT3D; plus clone headers V0030FT3D at 0x06C539 and V0020FT2D JPN Ver0202 20180418 at 0x06C571, and YAESU FT1D at 0x045304

name: USA / JPN / EXP destination codes
evidence: the literal USA JPN EXP as three 4-character fields; matches the EXP and ALL suffixes on the updater packages
